highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.2 improves GPU failure handling and fixes a SkSL raster-pipeline lifetime error.

bullets.detail: Prevents stale readbacks after failed flushes, restores resolve dirty tracking when a task does not execute, and includes the Imagination framebuffer-deletion workaround.
Fixes an upstream use-after-free in raster-pipeline code generation.
